create_habitat_env: create a Habitat 2.0 environment using habitat.Env with a YAML config and run an interaction loop
create_gym_env: create a Gym-wrapped Habitat environment using gym.make and step through random actions
define_custom_task: define a custom RearrangeTask subclass with reset logic and register it with the Habitat registry
define_reward_measure: define a custom RearrangeReward measure class with scaling factors and collision penalties
define_success_measure: define a custom Measure class to check if the agent is grasping the target object
